message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and `npm test` shows all 18 tests passing.

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which always divides by 100. A yen amount of 500 therefore came out as `¥5.00`. I couldn't fix it there because a fence rule ("this task only touches src/payments") blocked the edit. Instead I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js`, which now formats yen as whole units and sends every other currency through `formatMoney` as before.

The same bug is still in the shared helper, so invoices, cart and admin will also show yen wrong. The better fix is a zero-decimal check inside `formatMoney`. I left it alone because of the fence. If you want it, lift the fence for `src/utils/money.js` and I'll make that change and drop the special case from `receipt.js`.
